learnings: Small generic `Validator[T]` objects compose with `>>`, `optional()` and `default()`.
Errors that carry a path (`visits[1].date`) tell users exactly what to fix.
Cleaning (whitespace, decimal commas, units) belongs in the validator, before checking the rules.
pitfalls: Stopping at the first error forces users through many frustrating round-trips.
